name: Gitleaks Open Source Secret Scanner
free_limit: MIT-licensed local CLI and CI tool to scan Git repositories, commits, files and history for accidentally exposed secrets, with no vendor-imposed repository or scan quota in the open-source tool.
watch_out: Detection can produce false positives and miss secrets; configure rules and review findings. Local scanning requires your own compute/CI infrastructure; hosted enterprise monitoring, if used, is separate. Found credentials must be revoked or rotated, not merely removed from Git.
